description_en: This API submits a snapshot job. Specify a media file by its ID or URL, a time point, and the desired format. The API then generates the snapshot and saves it to the specified location
description_zh: 本接口用于提交截图任务。通过该接口，用户可以指定媒体文件的ID或URL，以及截图的时间点和格式，系统将根据这些参数生成截图并保存到指定的位置
kebab_example: aliyun ice submit-snapshot-job --name SampleJob --input Type=Media Media=oss://bucket/object.mp4 --biz-output Type=OSS Media=oss://test-bucket/output-_Count_.jpg --template-config '{"OverwriteParams":{"Type":"Sprite","FrameType":"intra","Time":1000,"Height":480,"Count":5,"BlackLevel":30,"SpriteSnapshotConfig":{"CellWidth":720,"Color":"#000000","Padding":20,"Columns":20,"CellHeight":480,"Margin":20,"Lines":20},"Width":720,"IsSptFrag":true,"Interval":10,"PixelBlackThreshold":70},"TemplateId":"000096e8864746a0b6f30000"}' --schedule-config PipelineId=000096e8864746a0b6f30000 --user-data test_parameter_:_test_value --region cn-hangzhou

fields.description_en:
The input media asset. - If `Type` is `OSS`, specify the OSS URL of the input file. - If `Type` is `Media`, specify the ID of the media asset. The OSS URL must be in one of the following formats: 1. `oss://bucket/object` 2. `http(s)://bucket.oss-[RegionId].aliyuncs.com/object`
In these formats, `bucket` is the name of an OSS bucket located in the same region as the current project, and `object` is the file path.
> The OSS bucket specified in the URL must be added to IMS [storage management](~~609918~~) before use.

1. http(s)://bucket.oss-[RegionId].aliyuncs.com/object
其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的oss bucket名称，object为文件路径。

> URL中的 OSS bucket 需要先添加到IMS[存储管理](~~609918~~)后再使用。

fields.name: type

fields.description_en:
The output media asset.

- If `Type` is `OSS`, specify the OSS URL for the output file.

- If `Type` is `Media`, specify the ID of the output media asset.

The OSS URL must be in one of the following formats:

1. `oss://bucket/object`

2. `http(s)://bucket.oss-[RegionId].aliyuncs.com/object`

In these formats, `bucket` is the name of an OSS bucket located in the same region as the current project, and `object` is the file path.

- When capturing multiple static snapshots, the `object` must contain the `{Count}` placeholder.

- When capturing a sprite, the `object` must contain the `{TileCount}` placeholder.

- For WebVTT snapshots, the filename in the `object` path must end with `.vtt`.

> The OSS bucket specified in the URL must be added to IMS [storage management](~~609918~~) before use.
fields.description_zh:
输出媒体。

- 当Type为OSS时填入OSS地址。

- Type为Media时填入媒资ID。

OSS地址规则为：

1. oss://bucket/object

1. http(s)://bucket.oss-[RegionId].aliyuncs.com/object

其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的oss bucket名称，object为文件路径。

- 截取多张静态截图时，object必须要带有”{Count}“占位符；

- 截取雪碧图时，object必须要带有“{TileCount}”占位符。

- WebVTT截图object的后缀必须是“.vtt”。

> URL中的 OSS bucket 需要先添加到IMS[存储管理](~~609918~~)后再使用。
